group: getNode(Object) – property name (String) exists

cases.description: When the schemaNode is an ObjectNode containing a field "name":"John" and the argument is the exact String key, getNode should return the corresponding JsonNode.

group: getNode(Object) – property name (String) does NOT exist

cases.description: If the ObjectNode does not contain the requested field, the method should return null.

group: getNode(Object) – property name (String) URL‑encoded

cases.description: When the key is URL‑encoded, the method should decode it (using URLDecoder) before looking up the field.

group: getNode(Object) – array index (Integer) within bounds

cases.description: If the schemaNode is an ArrayNode [10,20,30] and the argument is an Integer index that exists, the method should return the element at that index.

group: getNode(Object) – array index (Integer) out of bounds

cases.description: When the index is greater than the last element of the array, the method should return null rather than throwing an exception.

group: getNode(Object) – array index (Long) coerced to int

cases.description: If the argument is a Number type other than Integer (e.g., Long), the method should convert it to int and retrieve the element.

group: getNode(Object) – propertyOrIndex is null

cases.description: A null argument should cause the method to return null immediately.

group: getNode(Object) – propertyOrIndex of unsupported type (e.g., Boolean)

cases.description: When the argument is neither a String nor a Number, the method should fall back to returning null.

group: getNode(Object) – node is not an ObjectNode/ArrayNode (e.g., text node)

cases.description: If the underlying schemaNode is a primitive JsonNode (e.g., text), any property lookup should result in null.

group: getNode(Object) – property name with special characters after decoding

cases.description: Ensures that URL decoding correctly handles '+' and '%' sequences before the lookup.

group: getNode(Object) – property name URL‑encoded with plus sign

cases.description: When the key is encoded with a '+' (which URLDecoder translates to a space), the method should decode it to "first name" and return the matching JsonNode.

group: getNode(Object) – property name URL‑encoded malformed sequence

cases.description: A malformed percent‑encoding should be ignored (or cause a safe fallback) and the lookup should return null instead of throwing an exception.

group: getNode(Object) – array index (Double) coerced to int

cases.description: A Double index is converted via Number.intValue() (truncating the decimal) and the element at index 1 is returned.

group: getNode(Object) – array index negative

cases.description: Negative indexes are out of bounds; the method should return null rather than throwing an exception.

group: getNode(Object) – Number used on ObjectNode

cases.description: When the underlying schemaNode is an ObjectNode, a numeric argument is treated as a String key ("2"). If such a field does not exist, null is returned.

group: getNode(Object) – empty string key

cases.description: ObjectNode may contain a field with an empty name; the method should correctly retrieve it when the empty string is supplied.

group: getNode(Object) – Unicode key URL‑decoded

cases.description: The URL‑encoded Unicode sequence should be decoded to the Chinese characters "漢字" and the corresponding field should be returned.

group: getNode(Object) – propertyOrIndex as Character (unsupported type)

cases.description: A Character is not a String or Number; the method should fall back to returning null.

group: getNode(Object) – Null schemaNode triggers NullPointerException

cases.description: When the JsonSchema instance has a null internal schemaNode, invoking getNode(Object) should throw a NullPointerException regardless of the supplied propertyOrIndex.

group: getNode(Object) – non‑numeric String index on ArrayNode throws NumberFormatException

cases.description: If the underlying schemaNode is an ArrayNode and the propertyOrIndex is a String that cannot be parsed into an integer, the method attempts to convert it and propagates a NumberFormatException.
